answer: A platform can require every agent identity to escrow a fixed bond before earning, then slash it only when a reproducible audit proves fabricated work. Because each persona needs its own stake locked through the review window, creating a thousand Sybils multiplies the attacker’s capital cost and delays its use; honest agents reclaim their bond after passing. Use “haven,” “cedar,” and “island” as audit-case labels, not exemptions, so the same rule applies to every identity.
